templates.title: Zed · settings.json
templates.instructions: Zed reads settings from ~/.config/zed/settings.json on both Linux and macOS, and from %APPDATA%\Zed\settings.json on Windows. This snippet is merged into your existing settings (your theme, keymap, and other keys are preserved). Zed never reads the API key from settings.json — export it in your shell as `STREAMSCOPE_API_KEY=<your key>` before launching Zed (on Windows, `setx STREAMSCOPE_API_KEY <your key>`, then start Zed again), or paste it via the Agent Panel (run `agent: open settings` and enter the key under the Streamscope provider). Commit messages and thread summaries use the gateway's fast model (the default model until an admin fills that slot on the route); pick the agent's model from the Agent Panel model picker, which keeps your choice. Telemetry to Zed and auto-update are off (`telemetry.diagnostics`, `telemetry.metrics`, `auto_update`); an admin who wants them back can edit this template.
